main.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a production character model sheet / turnaround for the educational listening project Sentit. Use the attached radio illustration as the STRICT CHARACTER IDENTITY AND STYLE reference, not merely a style cue. Keep the same face, age, hair, colors, clothing, body proportions and personality in every view. High quality hand-drawn ink and soft watercolor, muted sage green / charcoal palette, white paper with quiet margins. Landscape 3:2 sheet, clean and legible, no scene background or radio props. Top row four evenly spaced full-body views, same scale and aligned feet: front neutral stance, true side profile, back, three-quarter view with arms gently open. Bottom row three larger head studies of the SAME person: front neutral, side profile, three-quarter smiling. Natural correct anatomy, no extra fingers, all figures fully within margins. One concise header only, no other captions, no watermark. This is a reference for drawing the very same person across future stories, NOT a cast of different characters. Character: ONLY the GIRL on the LEFT in the source, Laia, youthful around 12-14, warm brown curly hair in a loosely tied high bun with escaping curls, freckles across nose and cheeks, small thin hoop earrings, light sage green plain crew-neck sweater. Her face must match the girl at the microphone exactly. Extend the unseen lower outfit modestly with simple neutral trousers and plain sneakers. Do not depict the boy. Exact header: "LAIA · Veu: Leda".
